results.title: Brueggers Bagels - Crunchbase Company Profile & Funding
results.snippet: Brueggers Bagels is a bakery-café chain that specializes in kettle-boiled, oven-baked bagels. The company prepares bagels using a traditional boiling and baking method to produce a shiny crust and chewy interior. Brueggers Bagels offers a menu that includes a variety of bagel flavors, signature egg sandwiches, cream cheese spreads, and coffee.
